title: Permission
description: A permission rule evaluated before a tool runs: match a tool and its arguments, then allow, ask or deny.

tool.description: Tool name or glob, e.g. bash or edit.*.

pattern.description: Glob matched against the command or file path argument; empty matches everything.

mode.description: Action taken when the rule matches. First matching rule wins.

source.description: Scope the rule was declared in.

description.description: Why the rule exists; shown when prompting.
